Gegenstand der Vergabe ist ein Programmierbares Windfelderzeugungssystem für einen Wind-Wellen-Kanal. Technische Spezifikation 1. Beschaffungsumfang Die Beschaffung umfasst die Lieferung, Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Funktionsprüfung eines programmierbaren Windfelderzeugungssystems für den Betrieb über einem bestehenden Wind-Wellen-Kanal. Das System muss sämtliche für den Betrieb erforderlichen mechanischen, elektrischen, steuerungstechnischen und softwareseitigen Komponenten umfassen, einschließlich Tragstrukturen, Strömungskonditionierungselementen, Luftführungen, Steuerungssoftware sowie Kommunikationsinfrastruktur. Das System wird für wissenschaftliche Untersuchungen in folgenden Bereichen eingesetzt: - Wind-Wellen-Interaktion - Atmosphäre-Ozean-Austausch - Grenzschichtprozesse - Meeresgischt- und Aerosolerzeugung - Anwendungen der Offshore-Windenergie - Validierung numerischer Modelle 2. Wissenschaftliche und funktionale Anforderungen Eine zentrale Anforderung dieser Beschaffung ist die Fähigkeit, realistische atmosphärische Anregungsbedingungen über einer Wasseroberfläche zu erzeugen. Im Gegensatz zu herkömmlichen Gebläsesystemen von Windkanälen muss das angebotene System die kontrollierte und reproduzierbare Erzeugung sowohl von: - räumlich nicht-homogenen Windfeldern als auch von - zeitlich veränderlichen Windbedingungen einschließlich Böen ermöglichen. Das System muss daher: 1. aus mindestens 40 unabhängig regelbaren Ventilatormodulen bestehen, die in einem zweidimensionalen Array angeordnet sind; 2. Windgeschwindigkeiten von mindestens 20 m/s ohne nachgeschaltete Strömungsmanipulationseinrichtungen erzeugen können; 3. eine Beschleunigung (Ramp-Up) von mindestens 15 m/s2 ohne nachgeschaltete Strömungsmanipulationseinrichtungen ermöglichen; 4. eine Verzögerung (Ramp-Down) von mindestens 10 m/s2 ohne nachgeschaltete Strömungsmanipulationseinrichtungen ermöglichen; 5. die unabhängige Ansteuerung jedes einzelnen Ventilatormoduls erlauben; 6. beliebige zweidimensionale Windgeschwindigkeitsverteilungen erzeugen können; 7. asymmetrische Windprofile, Windgeschwindigkeitsgradienten von mindestens 7 m/s pro Meter sowie Scherprofile ohne nachgeschaltete Strömungsmanipulationseinrichtungen erzeugen können; 8. zeitlich veränderliche Windbedingungen und benutzerdefinierte Windgeschwindigkeits-Zeitreihen erzeugen können; 9. reproduzierbare Böenereignisse erzeugen können; 10. eine gleichzeitige räumliche und zeitliche Variation des Windfeldes ermöglichen; 11. vordefinierte Windszenarien speichern, reproduzieren und modifizieren können; 12. eine offene Softwareschnittstelle (API) für externe Steuerung, Automatisierung und Synchronisation mit wissenschaftlicher Messtechnik bereitstellen. Die Erzeugung komplexer, räumlich variierender und zeitlich instationärer Windfelder stellt eine wesentliche Anforderung dieser Beschaffung dar. 3. Windgenerierungssystem Das Windgenerierungssystem muss: 1. mindestens 40 individuell regelbare Ventilatormodule umfassen; 2. einen stabilen und reproduzierbaren Betrieb über den gesamten Betriebsbereich gewährleisten; 3. Steuerungssoftware Die bereitgestellte Software muss folgende Funktionen bieten: 1. eine grafische Benutzeroberfläche zur Bedienung des Systems; 2. individuelle Ventilatorsteuerung; 3. gruppierte Ventilatorsteuerung; 4. Erstellung und Speicherung benutzerdefinierter Windszenarien; 5. Programmierung zeitabhängiger Windfelder; 6. Import und Export von Windprofilen; 7. Skript- und Automatisierungsfunktionen; 8. eine offene API für wissenschaftliche Anwendungen. Die Software muss den Langzeitbetrieb sowie die zukünftige Integration in Laborsteuerungssysteme unterstützen.

description: Indonesia"s tropical forests are critical for global climate stability, yet they face widespread threats from unsustainable land-use practices, illegal logging, and forest fires, which cause significant deforestation and high Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions. While the Government of Indonesia aims for a 29% carbon emission cut by 2030 and has fostered new policies through decentralization, the key challenge remains implementation at the regional and provincial level. Differences in technical capacity, resource allocation, and inter-sectoral coordination may affect the consistency of monitoring, law enforcement, and sustainable forest management (SFM) planning required to support national commitments. The FORCLIME project aims to achieve two objectives (1) Climate Mitigation: To significantly reduce GHG emissions from the forestry sector and (2) Livelihood Strengthening: To strengthen local livelihoods without undermining conservation efforts. Im Rahmen einer Machbarkeitsstudie wurden verschiedene Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für den Standort untersucht. title: Germany – Health and social work services – 10032371 - Strengthening reproductive health and empowerment of young women
description: The project Strengthening Reproductive Health and Empowerment of Young Women (SRHEYW) is a module of German Development Cooperation in the health sector in Tanzania. It is commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH in cooperation with the Ministry of Health (MoH) and the Prime Minister"s Office - Regional Administration and Local Government (PMORALG). The project is implemented from July 2026 to June 2029 and focuses on Tanga Region. Despite progress in women"s rights and access to health services, many young people in Tanzania, particularly adolescent girls and young women, continue to face significant barriers to exercising their sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR). Persistent gender norms, unequal power relations, limited access to reliable information, high rates of adolescent pregnancy, unmet need for family planning, gender-based violence, and unequal access to services for young people with disabilities continue to undermine reproductive autonomy and health outcomes. The project aims to improve the reproductive autonomy and health of young women and newborns in selected areas of Tanzania. It focuses on strengthening maternal, neonatal, and reproductive health services; empowering young people with the knowledge and skills needed to make informed decisions regarding their sexual and reproductive health; improving the social and institutional environment that influences these decisions; and increasing access to SRHR services for people with disabilities. The intervention targets adolescent girls and young women while also engaging boys and young men, parents, teachers, religious and community leaders, health workers, civil society organisations, and government institutions. Particular attention is given to vulnerable groups, including young people living with disabilities and out-of-school youth. The project combines interventions at individual, community, institutional, and societal levels. Through youth clubs, community dialogue processes, social and behaviour change communication campaigns, and support to local civil society organisations, the project seeks to create an enabling environment in which young people can access information, utilise services, exercise their rights, and make informed choices about their future.

title: Germany – Sludge transport services – Nassschlammtransport
description: Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt für die Dauer von einem Jahr die Leerung der verbandseigenen Kläranlagen vom Nassschlamm sowie den darauffolgenden Transport des Schlammes zu den Kläranlagen in Gera oder Ronneburg. Es besteht die Option zur jährlichen Vertragsverlängerung um jeweils ein Jahr, maximal jedoch bis zu vier Jahre.Die Leistung umfasst die Abfuhr von Nassschlamm aus insgesamt 31 Kläranlagen und den Transport zu den Einleitstellen des Klärwerks Gera, nämlich zu den Faulschlammvorlagebehältern mit einem Gesamtvolumen von rund 6.022 m³ sowie zur Fäkalannahmestation mit einem Volumen von etwa 2.390 m³. Zusätzlich erfolgt die Anlieferung zur Einleitstelle Nassschlammannahme der Kläranlage in Ronneburg mit einem Volumen von rund 3.668 m³. Es handelt sich um Schlämme aus der Behandlung von kommunalem Abwasser (Abfallschlüsselnummer: 190805). Die Dichte des Nassschlammes wird mit 1 Liter ≙ 1 Kilo festgelegt. Da der Nassschlamm zu unregelmäßigen Zeiten anfällt und dieser abhängig von Wetterereignissen (Niederschlag und erhöhten Temperaturen) sowie der Entwicklung im Verbandsgebiet ist, stellen die angegebenen Mengen nur eine ungefähre Größe dar. Mehr- oder Mindermengen sind daher in die Einheitspreise einzukalkulieren und führen nicht zu Preisänderungen. Die Rahmenvereinbarung endet automatisch, sobald der Höchstwert von 710.000 € netto erreicht ist, unabhängig von der Vertragslaufzeit.

Within the metal area, the current infrastructure is limited to supporting research in E-PBF (Electron Beam Powder Bed Fusion). The purpose of this procurement is to acquire an easy-to-use metal additive manufacturing system with a relatively low variable cost that can be used for undergraduate education, research, and by the department's workshop. A technology well suited for these purposes is laser-based Wire DED (Direct Energy Deposition), which is the focus of this procurement. Several external research partners have also expressed interest in research using this technology. Wire DED enables printing in a variety of alloys and allows comparatively simple changeover between metals. This makes the technology useful for workshop, research and education activities. The wire feedstock also supports relatively low material costs and straightforward material handling compared with many other metal additive manufacturing technologies. A more detailed description of the procurement object and the requirements is presented in chapter 4, Specification of requirements.

The Department of Veteran Affairs Robert J. Dole VA Medical Center, located at 5500 E. Kellogg, Wichita, KS 67218 and hereafter referred to as VA, requires Contractor to provide homeless veteran services through a Safe Haven model of residential care at a facility located within 25 miles of the above Medical Center. These services, not to exceed 20 Veterans at any one time, are to be provided to homeless Veterans as defined in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). The VA National Center on Homelessness among Veterans ( the Center ) will provide ongoing training for program development for both contract providers and VA staff. Contractor will be evaluated based on the Center s established evaluation protocol and program fidelity measures. The goal of the Safe Haven Healthcare for Homeless Veterans (HCHV) program is to provide housing and case management services to Veterans and facilitate their access to a broad range of medical, mental health, and rehabilitative services utilizing Safe Haven low demand model guidelines. The target population for this HCHV Contract Residential Care Safe Haven is chronically homeless, chronically mentally ill Veterans, Veterans with chronic substance abuse disorders and complex needs. Safe Haven Programs, either directly or through linkage with community and other VA services, provide time-limited services such as supporting mental health stabilization, Substance Use Disorder (SUD) treatment services, enhancement of independent living skills, vocational training, and employment services. Emphasis is placed on referral and placement in permanent housing or longer-term residential programs utilizing VA and/or community resources. Lengths of stay in Safe Haven typically range from 4 to 6 months (all references to days within this contract refer to calendar days unless otherwise specified as business days) with the option to extend based on clinical need. Eligibility will be determined by the VA, based on Veteran status; meeting the McKinney-Vento Homeless Assistance Act definition of homelessness (see http://www.hudhre.info/hearth/ for additional information); and an assessment by the VA Health Care for Homeless Veterans (HCHV) program resulting in a determination of making the Veteran highly vulnerable and requiring Safe Haven services. This is an indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity contract for the period November 27, 2027, to November 26, 2032, in up to four 12-month options, if exercised, in accordance with FAR 16.5. 2. BACKGROUND AND OVERVIEW: The Secretary of the VA has set a zero-tolerance policy for homelessness within the Veteran population. As part of the Plan to End Homelessness among Veterans announced in late 2009, the Veterans Health Administration has been increasing both capacity of existing programs and services offered to program participants. The plan calls for utilizing new models of care not previously offered by VA. Recent national trends in service provision for the homeless outside of the VA system include the utilization of Safe Havens as an alternative to shelter care or as a placement after unsuccessful discharge from an in-patient or residential treatment program due to relapse-related issues. A is a form of supportive housing that serves hard-to-reach homeless persons with severe mental illnesses and/or substance use disorders. It is a low demand model of service delivery that allows clients to engage in treatment and services at their own pace. The VA s Plan to End Veteran Homelessness calls for enhancing current homeless service capacity as well as developing new programs and initiatives in concert with community and federal partners. This contract will enable a community provider to offer homeless Veterans services through a Safe Haven model of residential care. This model will offer services to homeless Veterans under the HCHV Contract Residential Care program enhanced by the services as defined in the PWS. Rapid stabilization of the Veterans medical, mental health, substance abuse and other psychosocial problems to place Veterans in other appropriate transitional or permanent housing within 4 to 6 months, with no more than 120 days without a formal written request by the Contractor for an extension which must be approved by the VA Liaison, is an expected outcome of this Contract. The community-based Contractor should have a minimum of 18 months experience with direct service to the homeless population and experience should be documented in the proposal. This contract will be awarded to a Contractor having an acceptable facility within 25 miles of the VA Medical Center. If no facilities are available within this area, consideration will be given to the Contractor whose facility meets all the stated requirements and is closest to the Medical Center. A VA Liaison to the Contractor will be identified by the homeless program leadership at VA. This individual will act as the clinical liaison for all client related issues between the Contractor and VA by providing clinical oversight. The VA Liaison will not provide direct clinical supervision to contract staff. The VA Liaison will consult with and provide input to the Contractor as needed. The Contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, housing, material and supplies necessary to provide emergency residential placement, treatment, and supportive services through the HCHV program Safe Haven Model. Services will be provided on-site at the Contractor s facility, in accordance with all terms, conditions, provisions and requirements listed herein. The prices provided in the Price Schedule shall be inclusive of all basic services as may be necessary in the treatment of the Veteran. Basic services shall be as defined in the Performance Work Statement. 3.
